blurb: Lotusland Yoga SF offers a variety of yoga classes including vinyasa, hatha, gentle flow, and meditation. They provide special events such as sound baths, kundalini rituals, and community workshops. The studio also offers a 1-month apprenticeship program for yoga teacher graduates and a 200-hour yoga teacher training program.
